samples.title: Highway drive (forward-moving camera)
samples.description: A 20-second 1280×720 clip from a camera moving forward along a multi-lane road.
samples.scenario: Forward camera motion through an outdoor scene with plenty of texture, which reconstructs well. It is NOT an indoor walk-through, and other vehicles move through the scene, which breaks the static-scene assumption and degrades the geometry where they appear. The scene scale is unknown, so all distances are relative.
samples.attribution: © 2017-2018 Udacity, Inc. Footage from the MIT-licensed repository udacity/CarND-Vehicle-Detection (project_video.mp4), trimmed to 20 s (24-44 s) and re-encoded as MP4 (H.264).
samples.note: We rely on the repository's MIT licence for this footage.

precomputed.computed_with: COLMAP 4.2.1 (pycolmap, CPU) and Depth Anything V2 Small, 100-keyframe limit, 800 px frames
